conforming_q1_control.boundary: Strong homogeneous exterior nodal Dirichlet pressure, no artificial gauge
conforming_q1_control.solver: Same original Q1 Galerkin operator with LOR PyAMG-preconditioned CG
conforming_q1_control.norm_convention: Exact common-partition pressure L2 and gradient polynomial integrals; relative full H1 includes both terms and uses the finer numerical field as denominator. An increment is not a bound on the finer field's continuum error.
conforming_q1_control.performance_convention: Single worker/native thread. Acquisition and full process time include their respective setup/solve/persistence work; host contention was not controlled. No speedup or scalability claim is made.
conforming_q1_control.coefficient_portability: The original reference NPZ pressure retains the recorded native 64-bit-mantissa long-double layout; its execution guard declares precision. Cross-host replay on a different long-double format is not certified by these reference archives.
conforming_q1_control.scientific_scope: Current guarded execution of the article's Q1/4096 reference space, with measured own refinements. The 2048-to-4096 full-H1 increment remains about9.77%; resolution is not demonstrated. MHM spaces retain local Q1/segmented P0, and their local resolution and complete Figure6 comparison remain separate acceptance tasks.

mhm_local_control.norm_convention: Full broken H1 = sqrt(integral(dp^2+|grad dp|^2)); denominator is the finer actual field, with independent one-sided fields in every macrocell. Existing exact tensor-product polynomial integration on the common nested partition is used.
mhm_local_control.scientific_scope: Local-discretization sensitivity of the stated fixed Q1/P0 MHM spaces and data. The finer MHM field is numerical; an increment does not certify continuum accuracy, classical reference resolution, or Figure 6 reproduction.

limitations: The Q1 finest-pair relative increments are approximately 0.99 percent in L2 and 9.77 percent in full H1.
Five numerical Q1 controls do not certify a resolved continuum reference or exact solution.
Fixed macro8x8/P0-trace MHM r128-to-r256 increments remain about 3.6-3.7 percent in L2 and 19 percent in full broken H1.
The MHM panels show local-resolution sensitivity across fixed trace partitions, not trace convergence or macro-mesh rates.
Earlier r32/r64 diagnostic increments retain their own acquisition IDs and qualifications; producer generations are not retagged.
